text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.4 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,926 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 153950
quotes.card: HD 153950 is a star in the southern constellation of Scorpius, positioned about 1.2° to the west of Eta Scorpii.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Rapeto, which was selected in the NameExoWorlds campaign by Madagascar, during the 100th anniversary of the IAU.
